title: When I Was Your Man

cues.en: Same bed, but it feels just a little bit bigger now
cues.zh: 同一張床，但現在感覺更大了一點
cues.text: Same bed, but it feels just a little bit bigger now

cues.en: Our song on the radio, but it don't sound the same
cues.zh: 電臺裡有我們的歌，但聽起來不一樣
cues.text: Our song on the radio, but it don't sound the same

cues.en: When our friends talk about you all it does is just tell me down
cues.zh: 當我們的朋友談論你時，所做的只是告訴我
cues.text: When our friends talk about you all it does is just tell me down

cues.en: Cause my heart breaks a little when I hear your name
cues.zh: 因為當我聽到你的名字時我的心有點碎
cues.text: Cause my heart breaks a little when I hear your name

cues.en: It all just sounds like you
cues.zh: 這一切聽起來都像你
cues.text: It all just sounds like you

cues.en: Mmm, too young, too dumb to realize
cues.zh: 嗯，太年輕，太愚蠢，無法意識到
cues.text: Mmm, too young, too dumb to realize

cues.en: That I should have brought you flowers and held your hand
cues.zh: 我應該送花給你並握住你的手
cues.text: That I should have brought you flowers and held your hand

cues.en: Should I give you all my hours when I had the chance
cues.zh: 當我有機會時我應該把我所有的時間都給你嗎
cues.text: Should I give you all my hours when I had the chance

cues.en: Take you to every party cause all you wanted to do was dance
cues.zh: 帶你去參加每個派對，因為你只想跳舞
cues.text: Take you to every party cause all you wanted to do was dance

cues.en: Now my baby's dancing, but she's dancing with another man
cues.zh: 現在我的寶寶在跳舞，但她正在和另一個男人跳舞
cues.text: Now my baby's dancing, but she's dancing with another man

cues.en: My bride, my ego, my needs and my selfish ways
cues.zh: 我的新娘，我的自我，我的需求和我自私的方式
cues.text: My bride, my ego, my needs and my selfish ways

cues.en: Cause the good strong woman like you to walk out my life
cues.zh: 讓像你這樣善良堅強的女人走出我的生活
cues.text: Cause the good strong woman like you to walk out my life

cues.en: Now I'll never, never get to clean up the mess I made
cues.zh: 現在我永遠永遠無法清理我造成的混亂
cues.text: Now I'll never, never get to clean up the mess I made

cues.en: And it haunts me every time I close my eyes
cues.zh: 每次我閉上眼睛它都會困擾我
cues.text: And it haunts me every time I close my eyes

cues.en: It all just sounds like you
cues.zh: 這一切聽起來都像你
cues.text: It all just sounds like you

cues.en: Mmm, too young, too dumb to realize
cues.zh: 嗯，太年輕，太愚蠢，無法意識到
cues.text: Mmm, too young, too dumb to realize

cues.en: That I should have brought you flowers and held your hand
cues.zh: 我應該送花給你並握住你的手
cues.text: That I should have brought you flowers and held your hand

cues.en: Should I give you all my hours when I had the chance
cues.zh: 當我有機會時我應該把我所有的時間都給你嗎
cues.text: Should I give you all my hours when I had the chance

cues.en: Take you to every party cause all you wanted to do was dance
cues.zh: 帶你去參加每個派對，因為你只想跳舞
cues.text: Take you to every party cause all you wanted to do was dance

cues.en: Now my baby's dancing, but she's dancing with another man
cues.zh: 現在我的寶寶在跳舞，但她正在和另一個男人跳舞
cues.text: Now my baby's dancing, but she's dancing with another man

cues.en: Although it hurts, I'll be the first to say that I was once
cues.zh: 雖然很痛，但我會第一個說我曾經
cues.text: Although it hurts, I'll be the first to say that I was once

cues.en: Oh, I know I'm probably much too late to try and apologize for my mistakes
cues.zh: 哦，我知道我可能已經太晚了，無法為我的錯誤道歉
cues.text: Oh, I know I'm probably much too late to try and apologize for my mistakes

cues.en: But I just want you to know
cues.zh: 但我只想讓你知道
cues.text: But I just want you to know

cues.en: I hope it buys you flowers, I hope it holds your hand
cues.zh: 我希望它給你買花，我希望它握住你的手
cues.text: I hope it buys you flowers, I hope it holds your hand

cues.en: Take you to every party cause I remember how much you loved to dance
cues.zh: 帶你去參加每個聚會，因為我記得你有多喜歡跳舞
cues.text: Take you to every party cause I remember how much you loved to dance

cues.en: Do all the things I should have done when I was your man
cues.zh: 做我當你男人時應該做的所有事情
cues.text: Do all the things I should have done when I was your man
